d: Zohran Mamdani is facing criticism over his remarks on the RSS, with critics calling his outrage selective given his comments on India, Kashmir and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, as well as his positions on other global leaders and conflicts. Meanwhile, the controversy over Kriti Sanon’s withdrawn Rakhi ad has reignited a broader debate over women, culture and morality. In this video, Hem Kaur Saroya examines whether Mamdani’s politics reflect a selective outrage—and asks why women’s choices continue to be policed.
